About - Third Sphere Skip to content Portfolio Funds Impact About Contact Updates Book Store T-Sync Portfolio Funds Impact About Contact Updates Book Store T-Sync Many dimensions of change History We probably look familiar. In 2013 we began our collective journey as Urban Us to combat climate change by reimagining and upgrading our cities. As our network and portfolio expanded, so did our perspective on how to best create a world that works for everyone. That shift in our thinking led us to look outside city limits for the agents of change that will build our tomorrow. You can learn more about the history of Urban Us and how we built the URBAN-X accelerator from 2017 to 2021. More on our history here Team Stonly Baptiste Blue Yana Andrea Klimova Shaun Abrahamson Miela Mayer Shilpi Kumar Roscel Asuncion STAR QUEST PULSE NOVA MATCHA ALIGN About Third Sphere Who are we? We’re a climate-focused venture fund that’s been helping shape the landscape of early-stage climate investing for over a decade. With nearly 100 portfolio companies, we’ve built a thesis and approach that tackles climate change from unconventional angles—about two-thirds focused on mitigation, mostly via electrification, and one-third on resilience and adaptation.
